purpose: what this person does for a living, in the rulebook's column and in the player's own words
ask: the occupation concept the player gave; when it has no rulebook entry, the core rule applies: name the closest entries with a clause each and let the player choose or delegate

purpose: what this person leans on when things go wrong: the body, the hands or the head, so the card's strong characteristic is theirs and not the dice's
ask: what the people who know them would say they are best at, or what they reach for first when a night turns bad

purpose: the one ability other people count on this person for, so it sits at the front of the skill lists and reaches a usable value
ask: what they get asked to do, or the thing they have done often enough that others rely on it

purpose: what this person has never been any good at, so a weak characteristic is theirs too
ask: never asked; filled only when the player volunteers it
